name: Barbell squat
description: A barbell squat is a squat with a barbell on the upper back. Lower until the thighs are below parallel, then stand back up.

items.content: Barbell on the upper back, held with both hands

stages.name: Eccentric
stages.description: Deepest squat with the barbell on the upper back, thighs below parallel, chest up, back flat.

stages.name: Concentric
stages.description: Standing tall with the barbell on the upper back, hips and knees locked.
